situations.headline: Iveda gets second Nasdaq bid-price extension to March 2027

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Iveda gets second Nasdaq bid-price extension to March 2027 (interest 3, risk 8)

thesis.text: Iveda is a micro-cap AI video/drone story with chronic Nasdaq bid-price non-compliance; this second 180-day extension to March 1, 2027 buys time but does not resolve the underlying issue, and management explicitly floats a reverse split as a lever, implying dilution/mechanical repricing risk ahead of the catalyst; commercial pipeline (IvedaAI, IvedaAir, CEREBRO) remains unmonetized per the company's own forward-looking caveats, so this stays a speculative, event-driven watch rather than a compounder.
